card.title: The Warning Was Already Here
card.instruction: Choose one early detail as the warning sign, then let every later development reveal a larger version of the same disaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They misspelled our wedding invitation. That was the warning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake names another couple. Help me scrape it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Same mistake, larger icing budget. Pass me a knife.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They booked that couple into our reception room too. We've both paid; I'm offering half.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The typo's taking half our wedding. Before you offer them my chair, check which name's on it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 invitation typo is the warning, A3 wrong cake repeats it at higher cost and A5 room mix-up threatens half the wedding.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 cake names cause A3 knife request; B4 double booking and half offer cause A5 guarding the next named item.

relationship.evidence: B2 proposes repairing cake text and B4 negotiates a practical room compromise.

heightening.evidence: B4 shared room makes A5 see the typo consuming the event and check the chair before conceding more.

specificity.evidence: A1 wedding invitation and B2 cake names establish the repeated name error clearly.
